metadata.description: Variadic sum. Coerces args via Number(); 0 args → 0.
Variadic subtract. 0 args → 0; 1 arg → negation; ≥2 args → left fold.
Variadic product. Coerces args via Number(); 0 args → 1.
Variadic divide. 0 args → NaN; 1 arg → reciprocal; ≥2 args → left fold.

metadata.name: parseRange
metadata.description: Parse range notation ("Seg!A1:B3", "1,1:2,2") → Range { at, shape }. Passes a Range struct through; null when unparseable.

metadata.name: rangeToKeys
metadata.description: Enumerate a Range (struct or notation string) into row-major member cel keys — the Key[] shape inputMap accepts.

metadata.name: json
metadata.description: (value) — turn any value into a pretty-printed JSON string (JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)). Use it to read an object/array cel as text instead of "[object Object]": =json(clients.C1) renders the chat message list as readable JSON.
